AuthenticGlobalLatest.definition: Guaranteed latest cluster state backed by verified live synchronization proof

AuthenticatedCommittedCheckpoint.definition: Committed status at term T cryptographically verified, but unverified subsequent commits may exist

AuthenticLocallyCurrent.definition: Reconstruction matches local checkpoint watermark, but global quorum certification unverified

AuthenticHistoricalVersion.definition: Valid signature but known newer committed checkpoint exists

UnverifiableFreshness.definition: Valid manifest signature without durable checkpoints available to verify currency

ConflictingAuthorityEvidence.definition: Divergent authentic checkpoints detected from conflicting or partitioned quorums
